|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} [[File:Conductivity aura screenshot.png|thumbnail|right|The aura version of Conductivity]] '''Conductivity''' is a [[spell]] that [[curse]]s all targets in an area, making them less [[Resistance|resistant]] to [[lightning damage]] and gives lightning damage a chance to [[shock]]. ==Skill Functions and Interactions== * '''Negative Resistances''': This curse can cause resistance values to dip into the negative if the base values are low enough. This will have the effect of increasing the damage above values listed on the [[character screen]]. For example, a monster that has 0% lightning resistance and then is inflicted with level 1 Conductivity will take 25% more (multiplicative) lightning damage than the spell or attack would normally cause. * Conductivity can be turned into an [[aura]] by linking it with either {{il|Blasphemy Support}} or {{il|Awakened Blasphemy Support}}. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Added
